caption: The drawing consists of three distinct geometric and floral-inspired designs on an off-white background. In the upper left, there is a circular motif composed of four red circles arranged in a square, each bordered by a green, jagged edge suggestive of leaves, and with a small white negative space cross at the center. To the upper right, there is a symmetrical, radiating design: at its core are four red hearts pointing outwards in a cross formation, surrounded by green curved lines and dots as well as small red triangular shapes and dots positioned symmetrically, creating a floral and starburst effect. At the bottom, there is a horizontal border design: two parallel, dashed green lines run horizontally, separated by negative space. Between the lines in the center is a motif resembling a red heart with two green crescent shapes placed above and below it, flanked on each side by small green and red starbursts consisting of dots and leaf-like shapes.
title: Stencilled Wall
